# GitHub logins whose fork PRs get the Bazel remote-execution farm
# (.github/workflows/bazel-farm.yml). One login per line; blank lines and
# # comments are ignored; matching is case-insensitive.
#
# Read only from the base branch (the pull_request_target run's own commit),
# never from a PR: editing this file in a PR changes nothing until it merges.
# Both the PR author and the user who triggered the run (opener or pusher)
# must be listed, and the PR must come from the author's own fork. A listed login gets same-repo-PR-level trust:
# its PR code runs with the RBE client certificate. Same list as gascity's
# .github/blacksmith-allowlist.txt.
